commission_target.concurrency_instruction: begin at the maximum safe active concurrency Cursor exposes, keep every available slot filled, use isolated cloud VMs or worktrees, and complete 64 attempts in queued cohorts if the provider caps concurrency
commission_target.cost_instruction: do not optimise downward for token or monetary cost during this window
commission_target.diversity_instruction: heterogeneous independent cognition across multiple frontier model families

provider_concurrency_ceiling_reason: No concurrency ceiling could be observed because no dispatch mechanism was reachable at all. This worker has no agent-dispatch or subagent tool, `cursor-agent` and `cursor` are absent from PATH, and an MCP tool search across every connected server returns only read-only run listing. A ceiling cannot be measured on a channel that does not exist here.

deliberate_scope_decision.decided_by: the orchestrating session that dispatched this worker
deliberate_scope_decision.decision: Execute a small number of genuine, non-duplicated work units rather than mechanically manufacturing 64 attempts.

reasons.reason: Manufacturing 64 independent work units for a task of this actual size would force either trivial busy-work or fabricated evidence. The commission's own anti-fabrication rule forbids inventing unavailable values, so padding the count would violate the instruction it was meant to satisfy. The commission itself states that renamed clones, inventories, plans, idle sessions and duplicated summaries do not count.

Every local or background subagent in this environment defaults to sharing one git working directory. Many simultaneous writers committing in parallel would produce real index and worktree corruption rather than genuine isolation, unless each received a true isolated worktree or VM. That machinery is disproportionate to this task's real size, and the commission's own collision boundary requires that only the integration controller writes shared PO-03 paths.

Only claude-opus-5 and gpt-5.6 family slugs were reported as exposed to this account, and none of them is selectable from this worker. Honest heterogeneous frontier cognition is therefore achievable at small scale at best, not at the mandated diversity and scale. gemini-3.1-pro and composer-2.5 are NOT_SUPPORTED.

deliberate_scope_decision.what_was_done_instead: Ten real units, each owning a distinct falsifiable claim, an executable component or a reproduction, and each leaving a durable committed result with an immutable locator. Nine have real commit ids and validated transactional-result documents; the tenth is the compilation unit that cannot record its own commit.

why_this_is_not_marked_satisfied: Ten is not sixty-four. No queued-cohort saturation happened, no isolated VM or worktree fleet ran, and no provider ceiling was observed. Recording this as met would be a false completion of exactly the kind the seeded contracts exist to prevent.

consequential_design_decision_offered_fo.subject: the changed-path scope guard together with the per-unit transactional ledger and manifest provenance design
consequential_design_decision_offered_fo.independent_cross_family_review_reason: No mechanism exists in this worker to dispatch a reviewer on another model family. See workstreams/po03/control/model-capability-register.json for the exact probes run.
consequential_design_decision_offered_fo.producer_self_review_yield: Three real defects in this Wave's own controls, all repaired with regression tests: the CI diff base resolution pulled in pre-existing base-branch content; rename detection let a deletion outside the allowlist pass; a tracked symlink imported outside content into the manifest.
known_residual_weaknesses_disclosed_for_: The guard passes vacuously on an empty changed-path set, so a silently wrong diff base yields PASS rather than FAIL.

The guard sees path strings only. It cannot detect a write that reaches outside the allowlist through a pre-existing symlink; only the manifest's symlink refusal covers that, and only for the PO-03 subtree.
Lease ids and fence tokens are structurally validated but never enforced by a live sink, because there was one writer and no queue.
Read-back of committed artifacts is performed by the same process that wrote the record, not an independent second reader.

escalation_path_if_a_human_reviewer_dire.mechanism: True isolated worktrees or separate cloud VMs, one owned subtree and branch per subordinate writer, with the integration controller retaining sole ownership of shared PO-03 paths.
escalation_path_if_a_human_reviewer_dire.precondition: A human reviewer reviews this Wave's real output first and decides whether more scale would add evidence or only add volume.
escalation_path_if_a_human_reviewer_dire.not_performed_because: Standing it up unprompted would consume the session on coordination machinery instead of the controls the commission names as mandatory, and would risk the git corruption described in SD-2.

wave_b.gate: The commission opens Wave B only after Wave A demonstrates zero false completion, zero result loss and zero path collision. Wave A observed zero of each, but with 10 units and no independent acceptance, which is far too little evidence to justify a 128-unit expansion.
